newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AWB cuts Australia wheat pool prices by A$3/tonne.
newsitem.headline: AWB cuts Australia wheat pool prices by A$3/tonne.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said on Monday it had reduced wheat pool prices by A$3.00 a tonne.

"The market has been pressured by good news on crop development throughout the world with needed rainfall occurring in the U.S. hard wheat belt and in Australia and Argentine wheat growing areas," Storey said.

"On the demand front the market is extremely quiet with U.S. new crop sales well below normal pace. Any sales opportunities that are arising are being keenly fought with Canada re-emerging as an aggressive competitor," he said.
Pool prices for 1996/97 wheat at May 26
Australian Prime Hard 13 pct protein 232.00 down 3.00
The next pool price update will be on June 9.
